scope: Exact commands creating and verifying the final release archive/index. Read-only discovery and writing this command record are excluded.

commands.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import gzip,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('docs/audit/artifacts/reference_fixture');sha=lambda data:hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest();index=json.loads((base/'release-evidence-index-final.json').read_text());manifest=json.loads((base/'release-final-completed-raw-archives.json').read_text())
for row in manifest['archives']:
 original=Path(row['original_path']).read_bytes();stored=Path(row['archive_path']).read_bytes()
 assert original==gzip.decompress(stored)
 assert sha(original)==row['original_sha256']==row['decompressed_sha256']
 assert sha(stored)==row['archive_sha256']
for path,digest in manifest['prior_archives_verified_unchanged'].items():assert sha(Path(path).read_bytes())==digest
for entry in index['records']:
 for info in entry['files'].values():assert sha(Path(info['path']).read_bytes())==info['sha256']
 for item in entry['recordings'].values():
  original=Path(item['original']['path']).read_bytes();archive=Path(item['lossless_archive']['path']).read_bytes()
  assert sha(original)==item['original']['sha256']==item['decompressed_sha256']
  assert gzip.decompress(archive)==original
  assert sha(archive)==item['lossless_archive']['sha256']
 if 'analysis' in entry['files']:
  analysis=json.loads(Path(entry['files']['analysis']['path']).read_text())
  assert analysis['source']['sha256']==entry['recordings']['rx']['original']['sha256']
assert len(index['records'])==10
recovery=next(row for row in index['records'] if row['label']=='release-cap8-final-recovery');res=next(row for row in index['records'] if row['label']=='release-res8-01')
assert recovery['capture_seconds']<120 and recovery['screening_duration_only']=='RECOVERY_ONLY_LESS_THAN_120_SECONDS'
assert recovery['existing_analysis']['parser_counters']['cap_frames']==257
assert res['collector_status']=='ERROR' and res['existing_analysis']['status']=='FAIL'
assert res['existing_analysis']['parser_counters']['resistance_frames']==26
assert index['final_observed_configuration']['CONFIG_atomic_snapshot']['mode']=='CAP'
assert index['final_observed_configuration']['CONFIG_atomic_snapshot']['rows']=='8'
assert index['final_observed_configuration']['USBSTREAM_separate_query']['v']=='DEBUG'
assert index['final_observed_configuration']['BAT_separate_query']['valid']=='0'
print(json.dumps({'status':'FINAL_EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_VERIFIED','new_archives':len(manifest['archives']),'prior_archives_unchanged':len(manifest['prior_archives_verified_unchanged']),'indexed_records':len(index['records']),'RES8_recorded_status':'FAIL','recovery_classification':recovery['screening_duration_only'],'final_query_CAP8_DEBUG':True,'battery_current_valid':False}))
